exposure: sequential use of vaginal misoprostol plus Foley catheter for labor induction
concurrent use of vaginal misoprostol plus Foley catheter for labor induction
outcome: number of doses needed to induce labor
need of oxytocin for augmentation of labor
cohort: 160 women with full term singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation and bishop score <= 6
finding: Concurrent use of vaginal misoprostol plus Foley catheter for labor induction was associated with a shorter induction-to-delivery interval compared to sequential use and increased the rate of vaginal delivery within the first 24 hours.
